plan.stop: No tuning or outcome-dependent stopping. All technical failures and unresolved retained. Pause after a completed move if readable quota<40%, or on user stop. Diagnose protocol failures before continuing, do not replace failed games.
plan.promotion: Screen only; no default promotion from four correlated layouts. Keep baseline even if promising. Report WDL, score, failures, costs and rule/build limitations.
plan.publication: Local code and report only; no commits, push or uploads. No third-party code or model copied into deliverable. Implementation independent; upstream conceptual references cited.
